newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to launch telecom satellite in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to launch telecom satellite in 1998.

text.p: Indonesia said on Wednesday it planned to launch a telecommunications satellite on board a Russian rocket next year to serve local cellular phone users.

"We are currently building the telecommunication satellite for mobile telephone use in Indonesia. We expect demand for mobile phones to continue to increase in the future," Tourism, Post and Telecommunications Minister Joop Ave told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
"We will launch the satellite, named Garuda, next year with a Russian rocket," he said. He gave no other details.
Indonesia already has three generations of telecommunication satellites built by Hughes Electronics Corp and launched by U.S rockets.
